title: WebGame Template — Play Free Online Games
description: A SEO-friendly template for building online game sites on Cloudflare Workers. Replace this with your own catalog of HTML5 games.

modules.heading: Welcome to your game site
modules.body: This is a starter homepage. Use the admin at `/admin` to add games, write guides, and customize this page. Every page is built from a few reusable modules: a game iframe, a video iframe, a page list, and SEO content blocks.

items.title: Fast and SEO-friendly
items.body: Server-rendered HTML on Cloudflare Workers — fast TTFB, perfect for search crawlers.

items.title: Composable modules
items.body: Every page is built from a few reusable modules you can rearrange.

items.title: Multilingual by design
items.body: Each page version is independent; hreflang and language switcher generated automatically.
